captions.detailed: A 3D-printable square cookie cutter featuring a concentric design. It consists of a large square outer cutting wall and a smaller, concentric square inner cutting wall that is slightly shorter than the outer wall. Both cutting walls are integrated into a flat, wide rectangular flange base at the bottom that acts as a structural grip frame.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric square cookie cutter in OpenSCAD with an option to include a smaller concentric inner cutting edge. The script should allow adjustments for the outer side length, outer height, cutting wall thickness, inner side difference, and the frame grip flange width.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a union of three main parts. First, a flat grip frame is created by differencing two centered cubes to form a square ring with a flange. Second, the outer cutter is built by differencing a centered cube with a slightly smaller concentric cube to establish a thin wall. Third, an optional inner cutter is conditionally added using an 'if' statement, created similarly by differencing two smaller concentric cubes, translated slightly along the Z-axis to adjust its height difference.
